story.title: Nvidia shares tumble after spy probe announced
story.summary: Shares of artificial intelligence leader Nvidia tumbled early Monday after the chip company said it launched an investigation of CEO Jensen Huang following reports he was targeted by Chinese intelligence. Nvidia shares were down more than eight percent in opening trading after its board announced that a committee of independent directors assisted by outside counsel would undertake the probe.

beats.caption: France blames Iran for mass-hacks targeting freezers in grocery stores and blood banks
Cooling systems across Europe hit by hackers.
beats.detail: France points the finger at Iran.
beats.narration: Imagine every freezer in your local shop going dark. This is not a glitch. It is a hack.

beats.caption: Thousands of industrial units targeted in waves.
beats.detail: Attackers focused on fridges and freezers.
beats.narration: That is not a random error. That is two waves of digital strikes hitting industrial cooling units.

beats.caption: France formally blames Iran for hacks.
beats.narration: The French foreign minister has officially blamed Iran for orchestrating these cyberattacks on critical infrastructure.

beats.caption: Essential food and medical supplies targeted.
beats.narration: The hackers targeted grocery store freezers, but also blood banks. This puts food and medical supplies at risk.

beats.caption: Attacks impacted wider Europe beyond France.
beats.narration: This was not just a French problem. The cyberattack spread across wider Europe, affecting multiple nations simultaneously.

beats.caption: A coordinated chain of digital sabotage.
beats.narration: First they identify the industrial systems, then they launch the digital strike, causing the cooling to fail.

story_card.headline: France blames Iran for major cyber-attack on food freezers
story_card.standfirst: Paris is pushing for European sanctions following a massive hack on supermarket cooling

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: France says Iran launched a massive cyber-attack against supermarket freezers and chillers last month.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The French foreign minister described the operation as an attack of unprecedented scale.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Targeting essential food infrastructure is a major escalation that threatens daily supply chains.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: France is now pushing for the European Union to impose new sanctions against Tehran.

story_card.caption:
France has officially linked Iran to a cyber-attack that targeted supermarket freezers.

The French government claims this incident was unprecedented in scale. Officials are now calling for a coordinated European response to hold Tehran accountable for the disruption.
